summary: Mutation-verified: dropping _packaged_source_digest from _base_fingerprint, deleting the Dockerfile's install-packaged-source.sh step, and making the installer leave stale files each turned 2 of the 3 annotated tests red (3/3 green at baseline); the docker-gated test proves the revised source actually executes in the rebuilt image. Caveat: the two non-docker tests run install-packaged-source.sh on the host, so they fail on BSD/macOS userland (rm/cp long options) and only pass on GNU coreutils.
